exposure: Third-trimester anemia (severe anemia <7 g/dL, mild-moderate anemia 7-10.9 g/dL, controls >11 g/dL hemoglobin)
cohort: Pregnant women between 28-42 weeks gestational age attending a tertiary care teaching hospital.
finding: Third-trimester anemia, especially in its severe form, is associated with substantial maternal morbidity (including pre-eclampsia, postpartum hemorrhage, ICU admission) and neonatal compromise (including preterm birth, low birth weight, NICU admission).
cross-section timing: Hemoglobin levels were measured and participants grouped between 28-42 weeks gestation.
